description: Dry run of a price rule for one sales channel in one currency, step 1 of 2; nothing is written. A rule prices every product on the channel from its base price (price + percent, then + fixed, then rounding) and moves with the base price; a product with its own price on the channel keeps that price. Pass rule null to go back to the base price. Returns how many products would change, how many have their own price, how many have no price in that currency, how many would sell below cost, sample rows before and after, and the digest set_channel_price_rule needs. Show the person this result before saving. Advertising channels (Google Merchant) cannot have a rule.

currency.description: The currency the rule applies in. list_channel_price_rules names the currencies each connected channel sells in.

platform.description: The sales channel, e.g. ebay or amazon.

fixed.description: Amount added to the base price after the percent, in the rule's currency. 0 for none.

percent.description: Percent added to the base price: 15 sells at base + 15%. Negative lowers it, down to -50. 0 for none.

rounding.description: How the result is rounded: cents (to the cent), whole (up to a whole number), nine (up to a whole number ending in 9), tens (up to tens), ninety_nine (ending in .99).

rule.description: The rule to check. null removes it: the base price again.

name: preview_channel_price_rule
title: Preview channel price rule
